title: 第378章 什么叫惊喜意外
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

帝王是没有办法谈情说爱的。

睡在皇帝身边的女人，不敢说自己不爱皇帝，哪怕是深宫再怎么幽怨，却也没法说自己不爱皇帝。

刘盈很清楚，现在他还年少，可以累计多少感情，也就意味着自己将来真正成为帝王之后，能和多少人谈感情，而不至于孤独寂寞到成为一个变态嗜杀的皇帝。

所以，现在一些在这个时代的人看起来肉麻的话，他倒是真的随口就能说出。

这也不是刘盈自己孟浪，而是他以前生活在一个爱一定要大声喊出来的时代，相对于这个时代，这些人普遍喜欢委婉表达爱的方式的时代，自然就显得无比肉麻了。

于是，宴会上虽然被刘盈赶走了一个人，但是大家却依旧在一种相对较放松的环境下吃肉喝酒。

大祭司提着羊腿奔马到了公孙玲珑战马边上的时候，依旧显得有些惊魂不定。

他抬起头来，就看到了明眸皓齿的小姑娘公孙玲珑。

小姑娘长得可爱，模样又讨人喜欢，腰间还挂着一把牛皮刀鞘的匕首，大祭司也就把手里挂在铁钩子上，还没冷掉的羊肉抬了起来，有些气喘吁吁的说道：

“来，尝一尝，冷了味道就变了。”

公孙玲珑点点头，拔出小匕首来，两人就这样在马背上割肉吃了起来。

“我看你这样子，这羊肉难不成是偷来的？后边有人在追你？”

“怎么可能？”大祭司摸出酒壶来灌了一口后，整个人算是彻底放松了下来：“这是太子赏赐的肉，我跑……奇怪，我自己也不知道，我为什么要跑……”

“你在害怕。”公孙玲珑从衣兜里摸出来了什么东西，然后撒在了羊肉上。

大祭司闻了出来，这是几种增香提味的香料，他尝了尝以后，觉得很满意，摇头道：“不是害怕，我说不上来……你是跟着谁过来的？你这样白净的娃儿，不是草原上的人，商贾们已经到这边来了？”

公孙玲珑愣了愣，她还以为大祭司知道自己是谁。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There is no way for emperors to fall in love.

The woman who sleeps next to the emperor dare not say that she does not love the emperor. No matter how resentful she is in the palace, she cannot say that she does not love the emperor.

Liu Ying knew very well that now that he was still young, how many relationships he could accumulate would mean how many people he could have relationships with after he truly became an emperor in the future, without becoming so lonely that he became a perverted and murderous emperor.

Therefore, if some people in this era seem disgusting, he can really say it casually.

This is not Liu Ying or Meng Lang, but he used to live in an era where love must be shouted out loud. Compared with this era, these people generally like to express love euphemistically, which naturally seems extremely disgusting.

Therefore, although Liu Ying drove away one person at the banquet, everyone still ate meat and drank wine in a relatively relaxed environment.

When the high priest came to the side of Gongsun Linglong's horse with the leg of lamb in hand, he still looked a little frightened.

He raised his head and saw the bright-eyed little girl Gongsun Linglong.

The little girl was cute, and her appearance was endearing. There was a dagger with a cowhide scabbard hanging on her waist. The high priest hung his hand on the iron hook, lifted the mutton that was still cold, and said breathlessly:

"Here, have a taste. The taste will change when it gets cold."

Gongsun Linglong nodded, pulled out a small dagger, and the two of them cut and ate the meat on horseback.

"Looking at you like this, could this mutton be stolen? Someone is chasing you?"

"How is that possible?" After the high priest took out the wine bottle and took a sip, he completely relaxed: "This is the meat rewarded by the prince. I ran...it's strange. I don't know why I ran..."

"You're scared." Gongsun Linglong took something out of his pocket and sprinkled it on the mutton.

The high priest smelled it. They were several spices that enhance the flavor. After tasting it, he felt very satisfied. He shook his head and said, "It's not that I'm afraid. I can't tell...Who did you follow? A fair boy like you is not from the grassland. The merchants have already come here?"

Gongsun Linglong was stunned. She thought the high priest knew who she was.
